author: iEMIL
quote: This game has undeniable performance issues, and yet somehow, most reviewers seem to have overlooked them. So here's my question to every journalist who reviewed it: WHY DIDN'T YOU DEDUCT POINTS FOR THE PERFORMANCE ISSUES? You would've done it for any other game, but apparently GTA gets a free pass simply because it's ROCKSTAR!!! Am I wrong? It's pretty obvious you were all paid off. At least now we know where Rockstar spent those $2 billion: BUYING REVIEW SCORES!
